definitions.explanation: A sustained human activity or way of living. Often refers to the fundamental activities that make up daily life, work, or cultural practice, with a nuance of continuity and purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{営|いとな}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧。
examples.english: Value the activities of daily life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{営|いとな}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひとつだ。
examples.english: Agriculture is one of humanity's oldest pursuits.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何百年|なんびゃくねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{漁|りょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{営|いとな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: In this region, the practice of fishing has continued for hundreds of years.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{営|いとな}み (human activity/endeavor)
- ⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{営|いとな}み (daily pursuits)
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{営|いとな}み (the activities of daily life)
- {営|いとな}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (continue a livelihood/practice)

The nominalized form of the verb ⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧ (to conduct, to carry on). Has a literary and somewhat elevated register, often used in essays, documentaries, and reflective writing to describe fundamental human activities with a sense of dignity and continuity.
